metricText: IRS SOI count of qualifying children behind child tax credit claims, per tax year.
note: UNVERIFIED offline candidate from the H.R. 2763 two-layer decomposition (bills/hr2763-119.json interactions): the American Family Act's specified-child rules change WHICH children qualify (no familial-relationship requirement in §24A(c)(1), monthly determination, presumptive eligibility), so a qualifying-children count is the direct transition benchmark alongside claimant returns. The registered irs.actc.total_claims series covers returns; no docket row or resolver covers children. The other two H.R. 2763 series hints are already registered (irs.actc.total_claims; census.spm.child_poverty_rate).
statisticalProduct: SOI Individual Income Tax Returns Complete Report (Publication 1304) / SOI child tax credit tables
